description.zh: 由主操作区与附属箭头组成的复合按钮：主区直接执行默认动作，箭头展开同组的备选菜单。比「按钮加独立下拉」少一次定位，比整键打开菜单的下拉按钮更快命中高频操作，常用于保存、发送、新建等带变体的动作。
description.en: A two-part button whose main area runs the default action while an attached arrow opens a menu of related ones. It saves a targeting step compared with a separate button and menu, and hits the frequent action faster than a dropdown whose whole face opens a list. Common for save, send and new-with-variants.

use_when.zh: 存在一个高频默认动作，外加若干同组变体
use_when.en: One frequent default action plus a few variants of it

use_when.zh: 希望默认动作一次点击即可执行
use_when.en: The default must fire in a single click

use_when.zh: 工具栏或表单操作区空间紧凑
use_when.en: Toolbar or form action rows are tight on space

avoid_when.zh: 没有明确默认动作，所有选项同等重要，用 dropdown
avoid_when.en: No clear default and all options rank equally — use a dropdown

avoid_when.zh: 备选动作与主动作无关，拆成 button 加 menu 更清晰
avoid_when.en: Related actions are loosely coupled — a separate button and menu reads clearer

avoid_when.zh: 只有一个动作，普通 button 足够
avoid_when.en: Only one action exists — a plain button is enough

note.zh: 主区与箭头左右并排，最常见形态
note.en: Main face and arrow side by side — the common form

note.zh: 箭头堆叠在主区下方，窄工具栏更稳
note.en: Arrow stacks under the main face for narrow toolbars

note.zh: 主区含图标加文案，识别更快
note.en: Icon plus label on the main face for faster recognition

task.zh: 分别点击主区与箭头，对比一次执行默认动作与展开备选菜单。
task.en: Click the main face and the arrow, comparing a one-shot default with the variant menu.

checks.zh: 主区与箭头是两个独立可聚焦目标
checks.en: Main face and arrow are two independent focus targets

checks.zh: 菜单打开时箭头呈展开态，Esc 收起并焦点归位
checks.en: The arrow shows expanded state; Esc closes and restores focus

note.zh: dropdown 整键打开菜单；split-button 主区执行动作、只有箭头开菜单
note.en: A dropdown opens a menu from the whole face; split-button runs an action on the main face

note.zh: 普通 button 只有一个动作；split-button 把同组变体收进附属菜单
note.en: A plain button has one action; split-button folds sibling variants into an attached menu

disambiguation.zh: 与 Dropdown 的差别是主区可直接执行默认动作；与「按钮加独立菜单」的差别是箭头在视觉与焦点上都附着于主按钮。
disambiguation.en: Versus a Dropdown the main face runs the default action; versus a separate button and menu the arrow stays visually and focally attached.

notes.zh: 两个按钮并排放在 inline-flex 中，接缝处去掉圆角与左边框形成一体外观；箭头用窄热区和 chevron 区分。菜单相对容器绝对定位。主区与箭头各自可聚焦，菜单打开后方向键在菜单项间移动，Esc 归位到箭头。
notes.en: Seat both halves in an inline-flex row and flatten the seam radius and border so they read as one control; give the arrow a narrow hit area with a chevron. Position the menu absolutely against the container. Each half is its own tab stop; with the menu open, arrows move through items and Esc returns focus to the arrow.

basic.zh: 创建一个分体按钮：主区执行默认保存动作，附属箭头展开保存并发布等备选菜单。
basic.en: Create a split button whose main face saves by default and whose arrow opens alternatives such as save-and-publish.

design.zh: 设计分体按钮。要求：主区与箭头视觉上连为一体，仅以细分隔线区分；主区文案明确动作名称；箭头用 chevron 并在菜单打开时旋转或高亮；菜单项与主区动作同组；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a split button. Requirements: the two halves read as one control split by a hairline divider; the main face names its action clearly; the arrow uses a chevron that rotates or lights up when the menu opens; menu items stay in the same action family; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现分体按钮：主区为普通 button，箭头为 aria-haspopup="menu" 的 button，共用一套高度与配色；接缝用负 margin 或 border-l-0 拼接；菜单绝对定位在箭头下方，打开时 aria-expanded="true"；支持 Enter 触发主动作、方向键浏览菜单。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind split button: a plain button for the main face and an aria-haspopup="menu" button for the arrow, sharing height and color; join the seam with a negative margin or border-l-0; absolutely position the menu under the arrow with aria-expanded="true" while open; Enter fires the default action and arrows walk the menu.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现分体按钮（Split Button）组件。
先检查现有按钮与菜单组件，优先复用配色、高度与浮层实现。
用途：保存、发送、新建等带变体的高频动作。
要求：
- 主区直接执行默认动作，箭头展开同组备选菜单
- 两个热区独立可聚焦，菜单打开态有可见反馈
- Esc 关闭菜单并把焦点还给箭头
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，深浅色一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Split Button component in the current project.
Inspect existing button and menu components first and reuse color, height and overlay primitives.
Usage: frequent actions with variants — save, send, new.
Requirements:
- The main face runs the default action; the arrow opens the sibling menu
- Two independently focusable targets with visible open state
- Esc closes the menu and restores focus to the arrow
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; consistent light and dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
